| # ISOBUS services and PGNs {#isobus-services-and-pgns-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                    |                                                                                                                                                                   |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

The ISOBUS communication stack supports the following services by receiving the corresponding PGN. These special PGNs are handled within the ISOBUS stack.

 

- [Address Claimed (PGN = 0xEE00)](address_claimed_pgn_0xee00.html){.topiclink}:

With this PGN another controller can ask for a comparison of the controller application (CA) names.

- [Commanded Address (PGN = 0xFED8):](commanded_address_pgn_0xfed8.html){.topiclink}

With this PGN another controller can change the address of the controller application (CA).

- [Name Management (PGN = 0x9300):](name_management_pgn_0x9300.html){.topiclink}

This PGN handles the name management according ISO11783-5.

- [PGN-Request (PGN = 0xEA00):](pgn-request_pgn_0xea00.html){.topiclink}

With this PGN another controller can request the specific PGNs.

- [Stop / Start Broadcast (DM13, PGN = 0xDF00):](stop_start_broadcast_dm13_pgn_0xdf00.html){.topiclink}

With this PGN another controller can suspend the sending of cyclic broadcast messages.
